entities.name: Jek
entities.description: A young Azorius mage fresh from the Academy and on the path to hieromancer, who protects his sister Vinni from Rakdos killers and dies.

entities.name: Vinni
entities.description: Jek's younger sister, who after his death climbs the One Hundred Steps and enlists as an Azorius arrester under the name Lavinia.

entities.name: The mad albino
entities.description: A Rakdos killer wielding a flayer's knife who hunts Jek for a Dimir key on behalf of his master and is killed by Vinni with her brother's dagger.

entities.name: Halok
entities.description: The person to whom Jek tells Vinni to give the Dimir key as evidence.

entities.name: Dimir key
entities.description: An ornate key bearing a Dimir guild seal that the Dimir want back.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The guild of law whose academy trained Jek and whose arresters Vinni joins.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: The secretive guild that wants its key back.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The carnival guild whose thugs, spike jester, chainwalkers and ogre hunt Jek and Vinni.

entities.name: Ogre of the Rakdos
entities.description: A chain-wielding ogre working for the albino who entangles Jek and is killed by Vinni.

entities.name: Ninth District
entities.description: A dangerous district of Ravnica where Jek and Vinni are trapped.

entities.name: One Hundred Steps
entities.description: The ancient stone staircase that is the gateway out of the Ninth District up to the Azorius Guildgate.

entities.name: Azorius Guildgate
entities.description: The gate at the top of the steps, beyond which a wide avenue runs across New Prahv to the Forum of Azor.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: The Azorius district with massive white towers, containing the Jelenn and Lyev Columns.

entities.name: Jelenn Column
entities.description: The hieromancer academy where Jek studied.

entities.name: Lyev Column
entities.description: The Azorius recruitment center for those who enforce the law, with an Office of Admissions.

entities.name: Forum of Azor
entities.description: An ancient Azorius site whose power Vinni feels from miles away.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild-ruled city-plane where the story takes place.

events.summary: Jek and Vinni hide in the walls of an apartment in the Ninth District, hunted by Rakdos thrill-killers over a Dimir key.
events.quote: Now, he and his sister, Vinni, crouched within the walls of the small apartment

events.summary: Jek hands Vinni his Azorius-etched dagger and shackles a spike jester with a spell, then they break out and fight their way into the street.
events.quote: Crackling blue energy flared out and shackled the spike jester with glowing Azorius glyphs.

events.summary: An ogre's chains catch Jek, and the albino knocks Vinni down and demands the key.
events.quote: "Jek, Jek, Jek. You have something that my master wants," the albino hissed.

events.summary: The albino stabs the helpless Jek with his flayer blade.
events.quote: the albino plunged his flayer blade into Jek's helpless body.

events.summary: Vinni stabs the mad albino in the throat with her brother's dagger and kills him.
events.quote: The albino collapsed, face first, in a heap at Vinni's feet

events.summary: Jek empowers the dagger with a last spell and Vinni kills the ogre.
events.quote: She lunged at the weakened ogre and peppered him with jabs from her dagger until the brute ceased to move.

events.summary: Jek gives Vinni the Dimir key as evidence for Halok, tells her to go to the Jelenn column, and dies.
events.quote: Vinni. Take this. It's evidence. Give it to Halok.

events.summary: Grief-stricken Vinni climbs the One Hundred Steps out of the Ninth and passes the Azorius Guildgate, no longer a child.
Vinni walks into the Lyev Column, announces herself as Lavinia and asks to become an arrester.
events.quote: "My name is Lavinia. I want to be an arrester."

relations.quote: Now, he and his sister, Vinni, crouched within the walls of the small apartment

relations.note: Jek studied at the Azorius Academy.
relations.quote: Jek was fresh out of the Azorius Academy

relations.note: The albino stabs Jek with his flayer blade.
relations.quote: the albino plunged his flayer blade into Jek's helpless body.
A slender blade with Azorius sigils appeared from the mad albino's throat

relations.note: The ogre calls the albino Boss.
relations.quote: "Shall I tear up the other one, Boss?" the ogre asked.

relations.note: The key bears the Dimir guild seal.
relations.quote: It felt cold and had a Dimir guild seal on it.
